Every Way Woman

“Different Women, Different Opinions, Great Conversations”

A talk show created by women—real women having real conversations and finding real solutions. It embraces viewpoints from women of all colors, creeds, political affiliations, and religious backgrounds.

The founder · On air.

Yolando Mitchell Brown

@yolandomitchellbrown

A coach, business owner, producer, teacher, and visionary who launched a talk show for women right from her living room. When she lost the studio she depended on, she opened her own—creating a creative space where others could afford to chase their dreams.

Before you reach out

What the current site establishes—and what still needs to be confirmed.

What does InaviZion Media produce?

It creates and produces original OTT content for its network, including the legacy of Every Way Woman, The Movement, and Talk Show Land.

Who can use the creative space?

The live site positions it for independent producers and creative entrepreneurs, with uses including workshops, classes, events, podcasts, and film productions.

Where is My Creative Space?

The current site identifies My Creative Space in Burbank, California. A complete street address is not included in this redesign draft.

Is studio pricing published?

No pricing was provided on the current live site content used for this redesign. Availability, rates, and booking terms need confirmation directly from the studio.

Is Start The Possible a recorded course?

No. It is described as real-time, hands-on business coaching for beginners, with no pre-recorded fluff and no upsells.

How do I contact the team?

The current live site content provided for this redesign did not include a confirmed email address or phone number. Those contact targets are marked for confirmation below.
